topics.label: Introduction to cancer evolution and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, outlines the core themes of cancer evolution and microenvironment, and states the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian selection and clonal expansion driven by progressive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and the cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine whether cancers originate from and are maintained by stem-like cells, presenting evidence from tissue hierarchies, leukemia, and colorectal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with genetic mutations to enable and maintain malignant growth.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the sequencing, spatial profiling, and computational modeling methods used to study tumor heterogeneity and cellular interactions in the laboratory.

topics.label: Integrated model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental influences into a unified evolutionary framework of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the lecture and previews the upcoming session on therapy.
